hints.text: The $x$ outside the parentheses multiplies every term inside them. This is the distributive property.
Multiply $x$ by each term in turn: first $x \times x$, then $x \times 5$. Add the two products.
$x \times x = x^2$ and $x \times 5 = 5x$, so the product is $x^2 + 5x$.

explanation: Use the distributive property to multiply the outside $x$ by both terms inside the parentheses.
The first product is $x \times x = x^2$, because two copies of $x$ are multiplied.
The second product is $x \times 5$, which is written $5x$.
Adding the two products gives the answer $x^2 + 5x$.

alternativeExplanations.title: Area picture
steps: Draw a rectangle x tall and (x + 5) wide, split into two patches: one x wide, one 5 wide.
The patches have areas x·x = x² and x·5 = 5x. Total area: x² + 5x.

alternativeExplanations.title: Test a value
steps: The answer form gives 2² + 5·2 = 4 + 10 = 14. Same value — the multiplication is correct.
